name: Xiaomanlv
def: Low speed autonomous parcel van that delivers packages on Chinese university campuses and residential districts, developed by Alibaba and operated by its Cainiao logistics arm.
body: Xiaomanlv is a compact low speed electric delivery vehicle with a locker body, built to run the final stretch from a campus parcel station to a dormitory or apartment block. It navigates with lidar and cameras at bicycle speeds and drops parcels at pickup points where recipients unlock a hatch with a code. The vehicle came out of Alibaba's DAMO Academy research group and was folded into Cainiao's logistics operation. Fleets work several hundred Chinese campuses.
facts: Unveiled at Alibaba's Apsara conference in September 2020 as a DAMO Academy project
Deployed across several hundred university campuses in China
specs: Four wheeled low speed electric vehicle with a parcel locker body
Battery electric drive with swappable batteries
Level 4 autonomy limited to campuses and low speed roads, with remote monitoring
